[GOOS:windows] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'
[GOOS:plan9] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd herd

# The linter and the race detector accept a herd of children that sleep:
# no memory is raced, and the group joins in the end.
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
[race] [cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[race] [cgo] logos test -race -count=1 ./free
[race] [cgo] stdout '^ok '

# The monitor names the go group statement and the spawn that made the
# count reach the limit of the monitor, and the finding makes the exit
# status 1.
! logos conc run ./free
stdout '^herd done$'
stdout '^.*free[/\\]main\.lgo:12: \[conc::group_unbounded\] a group without a limit runs 10000 children at one time; the count follows the work the program gives the group$'
stdout '^\t.*main\.lgo:12: this go group has no limit$'
stdout '^\t.*main\.lgo:15: the child that made the count reach 10000 started here$'
stdout '^\tfix: '
stdout -count=1 'group_unbounded'

# The test binary links the monitor too.
! logos conc test -count=1 ./free
stdout '^ok '
stdout -count=1 'group_unbounded'

# The same herd behind a limit stays silent, and the program still ends.
logos conc run ./capped
stdout '^herd done$'
! stderr .
! stdout 'conc::'
logos conc test -count=1 ./capped
stdout 'no test files'
! stdout 'conc::'

-- herd/go.mod --
module example.com/herd

go 1.27
-- herd/free/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

func herd(ctx context.Context) error {
	var started sync.WaitGroup
	go group (ctx) {
		for range 10000 {
			started.Add(1)
			go {
				started.Done()
				time.Sleep(2 * time.Second)
			}
		}
		started.Wait()
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := herd(context.Background()); err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("herd done")
}
-- herd/free/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestHerd(t *testing.T) {
	if err := herd(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
-- herd/capped/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

func idle() error {
	return nil
}

func herd(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx, limit = 100) {
		for range 10000 {
			go idle()
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := herd(context.Background()); err != nil {
		fmt.Println(err)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("herd done")
}
